lines.zh: 蹄子踩碎薄冰，声音很脆。
lines.en: Hooves crack the thin ice with a snap.
Snow to my knees, and I still walk.

lines.zh: 獠牙向前伸着，用来开路。
lines.en: My tusks point forward, clearing the way.
The saddle on my back shifts as I walk.

lines.zh: 这片平地太空，我巡一圈。
lines.en: This flat land is empty; I make a round.
My breath turns to white mist and blows away.

lines.zh: 雪地上一串深坑，是我的。
lines.en: That line of deep prints is mine.
My coat is thick; the wind can't get in.

lines.zh: 我低着头走，獠牙蹭着雪。
lines.en: I walk head down, tusks brushing snow.
The ice is slick; I spread my hooves.
Back and forth, until the snow turns to mud.
I don't detour; I shove through.

lines.zh: 前面有片冻硬的苔，正合适。
lines.en: A patch of frozen moss ahead — just right.

lines.zh: 蹄声闷闷的，雪把响都吃了。
lines.en: My hooves thud dully; the snow eats the sound.
Don't even think about touching my flames.

lines.zh: 雪地上有疣猪兽的味道。
lines.en: Hoglin smell on the snow.

lines.zh: 岩浆味混着雪，今天不错。
lines.en: Lava smell mixed with snow; a good day.
This road burns my feet. I love it.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙，专拱雪下的根。
lines.en: My tusks root up what lies under the snow.
Snort; my breath freezes in the air.
Flames follow wherever I walk.
Something warm lies under the snow.

lines.zh: 挡在冻原上的，都给我让开。
lines.en: Anything on the tundra, get out of my way.
Tundra snow gives way under me.

lines.zh: 这片冻土，我拱过每一寸。
lines.en: I have rooted every inch of this permafrost.

lines.zh: 雪原上的獠牙，先拱一下。
lines.en: On the tundra, tusks go first.
I stand still and snort through my nose.

lines.zh: 獠牙上结了霜，我甩了甩。
lines.en: Frost on my tusks; I shake it off.
Wind from the north, carrying ice grains.
I rub my back against a dead tree.
The moss is frozen; I can't bite through.
Snow settles on my back; I leave it.
I know this smell — mushroom.

lines.zh: 远远有声响，我抬了抬头。
lines.en: A sound far off; I raise my head.
This place is cold and clean.
I bite the ice; cold runs down my throat.
I paw the snow twice.
Snow in my eye; I blink it out.
I lower my head against the wind.
I can sleep standing; keep quiet.

lines.zh: 雪地上只有我自己的脚印。
lines.en: Only my own prints mark the snow.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子埋进雪里找根茎。
lines.en: I push my snout into the snow for roots.

lines.zh: 风把我的鬃毛吹向一边。
lines.en: The wind pushes my mane to one side.
The frozen ground underfoot is hard as iron.

lines.zh: 疣猪兽的祖先，脑子不太好。
lines.en: Ancestor of hoglins. Not much upstairs.
Snow. Snow. Still snow.
Too warm by the fire, even my tusks relax.

lines.zh: 雪原上刨食，蹄子都冻了。
lines.en: Rooting in the snow, my hooves freeze.
The cold has frozen my snout stiff.
So quiet my ears hurt.
This rock really looks like my uncle.

lines.zh: 雪原里我一路拱，獠牙先到。
lines.en: On the tundra I root along, tusks first.

lines.zh: 雪原上，我的獠牙先拱地。
lines.en: On the tundra, my tusks root first.
It is only wind through pine branches.

lines.zh: 你身上没毛，怎么不怕冷。
lines.en: You've got no fur — how are you not cold?
I'm staring at that bunch of grass in your hand.

lines.zh: 再往前，蹄子就抬起来了。
lines.en: One more step and my hooves come up.

lines.zh: 你在雪地上踩出声，太吵。
lines.en: You crunch the snow; it's too loud.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，也不想知道。
lines.en: I don't know you, and I don't care to.

lines.zh: 獠牙比你手臂长，看好了。
lines.en: My tusks are longer than your arm — note that.
You stepped back; that's smart of you.

lines.zh: 背上的鞍不是给你坐的。
lines.en: The saddle isn't there for you to sit on.
You smell faintly of piglin.

lines.zh: 你手里那朵蘑菇，颜色不对。
lines.en: That mushroom in your hand is the wrong color.
Snow's piling on your head and you still stand.
I'll see which way you're headed.
These tusks are older than pigs.
You carry a pack; are you here to feed me?
Stop, and take off that hood.

lines.zh: 雪原上，活人越来越少了。
lines.en: Living folk grow rare on this tundra.

lines.zh: 你的脸，我刻在獠牙上了。
lines.en: I have carved your face on my tusk.
Why are you shaking?

lines.zh: 你身上有冻土和铁的味道。
lines.en: You smell of frozen earth and iron.

lines.zh: 雪原上，我这身子最抗冻。
lines.en: On the tundra, my body endures the cold best.
What did you bring me?

lines.zh: 又一个在雪原里迷路的。
lines.en: Another one lost in the snowfield.
My tusk took a knock and went numb.

lines.zh: 谁在我侧腹上划了一道。
lines.en: Someone opened a line on my flank.
I step back; the snow gives way.
Thick coat, but not beyond feeling pain.
That blow goes into my ledger.
My hoof slipped and caught itself.
Another strap on the saddle snapped.
Don't think my turning means fear.
My snout snorts white; I hold the anger.
Hit me again and I stop retreating.
Back off; my tusks are heating up.
My hooves have cut two furrows in the snow.

lines.zh: 雪原上，谁碰了我的獠牙？
lines.en: Who touched my tusks on the tundra?

lines.zh: 雪地里混久了，这点不算。
lines.en: Raised in snow, this is nothing.

lines.zh: 疼得我鼻子里直冒白气。
lines.en: Pain makes white steam pour from my snout.

lines.zh: 皮再厚，也怕你砍同一处。
lines.en: Thick hide still fears a blade in one spot.

lines.zh: 轻点，獠牙都给我打歪了。
lines.en: Easy, you knocked my tusk crooked.

lines.zh: 雪地上这点红，很快就被盖住。
lines.en: This red on the snow will be covered soon.
Again, and there is still snow on my hide.
My mane has thickened another layer.
The brown one — hand it over first.

lines.zh: 这味道一进来，我脾气就软。
lines.en: That smell comes in and my temper softens.

lines.zh: 红色的是另一回事，别弄混。
lines.en: The red one means something else; don't mix them up.

lines.zh: 嚼着蘑菇，我背上的毛平了。
lines.en: Chewing mushroom, the hair on my back lies flat.
Not too close; let me sniff first.

lines.zh: 冻苔不好吃，蘑菇才像样。
lines.en: Frozen moss is poor food; mushroom is proper.

lines.zh: 再喂一朵，我让你摸一下。
lines.en: One more, and you may touch me once.
Keep the red one; I have a use for it.

lines.zh: 你从哪儿找的，雪下可没有。
lines.en: Where did you find it? Not under this snow.
I'll eat and go; don't follow.
Gold? Let me see that.
You raise it and lower it; teasing me?
Toss over a frozen berry, just one.
I smell the salt in your pack.
Even my breath smells sweet now.
Do not back away; my tusks are held back.
These tusks belong to the tundra.

lines.zh: 那股菌子味，勾得我发慌。
lines.en: That mushroom smell makes me restless.
The sweet roots in your coat; do not hide them.

lines.zh: 这东西，我的獠牙挑得动。
lines.en: My tusks can lift that.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，等于撞一堵墙。
lines.en: Bumping me is like bumping a wall.
I shifted aside, or you'd be down.
My hoof landed by your boot.
Move; I need room to turn.
My bones are hard; the bruise is yours.
Don't pull my fur; it won't give.
We've churned the snow into slush.
The girth strap loosened from that knock.
Two steps back, and I won't chase.

lines.zh: 獠牙擦过你肩膀，算你运气。
lines.en: My tusk grazed your shoulder — lucky.
You knocked the fire on my back askew.
These tusks of mine don't check direction.
My tusks are already against you.

lines.zh: 雪原上只有我这副獠牙。
lines.en: Only these tusks of mine belong on this tundra.
You are a shade harder than permafrost.

lines.zh: 我鼻子里喷的气，都是热的。
lines.en: The air from my snout comes out hot.
One toss of my tusks and you're airborne.

lines.zh: 冻原的雪，比我獠牙还硬。
lines.en: The tundra snow is harder than my tusks.
Move; I never go around.

lines.zh: 谁撞的？我的獠牙还没收。
lines.en: Who hit me? My tusks are still out.

lines.zh: 红蘑菇吃下去，她就懂了。
lines.en: She eats the red mushroom and understands.

lines.zh: 两只并肩，獠牙对着前面。
lines.en: Two of us side by side, tusks forward.
I nudge her neck with my snout.

lines.zh: 这块平地够大，能养一窝。
lines.en: This flat ground is big enough for a litter.

lines.zh: 雪堆后面，我们挤在一起。
lines.en: Behind a snowdrift we press together.
Each step she takes caves the snow.
The young are born with tusks.
We circle, packing the ground down.

lines.zh: 别靠近，这时候獠牙最横。
lines.en: Stay back; my tusks are worst right now.
When they can run, I'll drive them off.
The snow in your fur smells good.
Easy, let me scent you first.
The snow is used to my low rumbling.
If wolves come, my tusks will hold.

lines.zh: 雪原上，两副獠牙对上了。
lines.en: On the tundra, two sets of tusks meet.
Usually I only grunt and charge.
Stay. Just tonight.

lines.zh: 一起拱开这片雪，怎么样。
lines.en: Shall we root this snowfield open together?

lines.zh: 站到我獠牙能护住的地方。
lines.en: Stand where my tusks can guard you.
Blink once and I will understand.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我一脚踩过去。
lines.en: Whatever's on the ground, I step on it.
I don't pick things up; hooves can't grip.
Mushrooms I take straight in my mouth.
That pile of yours is in my way.
A snowball rolls up; I kick it aside.

lines.zh: 鞍上挂的东西掉了，随它。
lines.en: Something fell off the saddle; let it lie.
I mind food and nothing else.
A horseshoe's loose; it clinks as I walk.
Someone dropped moss here; it's frozen hard.
Don't watch the ground; watch my tusks.
Another one. Profit.
Mine. All mine now.

lines.zh: 疣猪兽的祖先，捡东西不客气。
lines.en: The boar's ancestor takes what it finds.
I drag this frozen meat back to my den.

lines.zh: 这个带回去，同伴会羡慕。
lines.en: Take this back and the others will envy me.
The roots under the pine needles are mine.
I bury it in snow and fetch it later.
A clutch of frozen eggs; lucky day.
This meat froze hard, but it's still usable.
Ice chips glint; I tuck them in my fur.

lines.zh: 你踏进这片平地，我看见你了。
lines.en: You stepped onto my flats; I see you.

lines.zh: 雪上有你的脚印，还很新。
lines.en: Your tracks in the snow are still fresh.
That warm smell — something alive.
It's turned away; good for a start.

lines.zh: 我低下头，獠牙对着前面。
lines.en: I lower my head, tusks pointing ahead.
This thing is inside my boundary.
It didn't run, so I won't be polite.

lines.zh: 风把它味道送过来，够近。
lines.en: The wind brings its scent; close enough.

lines.zh: 我刨了下雪，先给个信号。
lines.en: I paw the snow as a warning.
If it backs off, I stop.

lines.zh: 这对獠牙，是疣猪兽的祖传。
lines.en: These tusks are heirlooms from the hoglins.
On the snowfield, my tusks clear the way.
Warmth on the tundra — that's you.
Come on, do not make me chase far.
That warm shape in the snow, hold still.
My snout has already caught you.
This time I will pin you against a tree.
Behind the snowbank, I smell you.
Your steps crunch too loudly in the snow.
I'm the ancestor of the hoglin.
Good, I will start with your knees.

lines.zh: 我的小眼睛盯住你喉咙。
lines.en: My small eyes lock on your throat.
On this tundra there is only us two.
You, warm as a live coal.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过去，不急。
lines.en: I close in step by step, unhurried.
The snow creaks under my hooves.

lines.zh: 我压低獠牙，跟着你的转向。
lines.en: I lower my tusks and mirror your turn.
This is close enough for a charge.
I snort once so it hears me.
No circling; I come straight.
It raises a hand — too late.
My hooves are already pawing.

lines.zh: 这一步落下去，就撞上了。
lines.en: One more step and we collide.
It backs to a drift; no way out.
A cliff ahead; you cannot stop in time.
I can wait until you start shivering.
I have not even shaken the snow off.
On the snow, I paw twice first.

lines.zh: 雪把每一步都替我记下。
lines.en: The snow records every step for me.

lines.zh: 你的汗味在冷空气里很重。
lines.en: Your sweat hangs heavy in the cold air.
Ten more steps and the snow runs out.
The snow is deep — you cannot outrun me.
I know this path blind.
My four hooves grip the snow better.
In the snowfield, tusks come out first.
On the tundra my hoofprints sink deepest.

lines.zh: 积雪冻原上，我的獠牙先探路。
lines.en: On the snowy tundra, my tusks lead.
Chasing you over snow. Don't lose a boot.
One tusk flick and it leaves the ground.
I drive in with my whole shoulder.
One thrust goes through hide armor.
It flies off and lands in the snow.

lines.zh: 獠牙一挑，把你抛向半空。
lines.en: One tusk flick sends you into the air.

lines.zh: 獠牙从下往上，专挑软的。
lines.en: Tusks sweep upward, hunting soft spots.
I thrust, step back, thrust again.
It's stuck on my tusk and can't shake free.
I toss it high and let it fall.
This hit will stay in its bones.
Head down, tusks sweeping up!
You can ride my back. Not for long.

lines.zh: 疣猪兽的祖先，力气更大。
lines.en: Hoglin ancestor — and stronger.
Did you hear hooves pounding the snow?
Let my tusks do the talking.
One gore and you are in the snow.
Do not scream; sound carries far here.
My tusks are faster than your legs.

lines.zh: 雪原的蹄子，踩得比谁都实。
lines.en: Snowfield hooves plant harder than any others.
Stand firm; here come my hooves again.

lines.zh: 我这獠牙，是疣猪兽的老祖宗。
lines.en: These tusks are the hoglin's ancestors.
Tusks down — here I come.
My breath melts the snow before I reach you.
Ancestor of the hoglin — heavier tusks.

lines.zh: 雪原上风一停，我就在了。
lines.en: The wind dies on the snowfield, and I'm here.

lines.zh: 我从冰雾里走出，蹄声先到。
lines.en: I come out of the ice fog, hooves first.
No one has come here in centuries.
My tusks go white in the snow glare.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，闻到生人的味道。
lines.en: I raise my head and smell a stranger.

lines.zh: 一整片平地，都是我走的。
lines.en: This whole flat is mine to walk.
I pack the snow underfoot and stand.

lines.zh: 背上的鞍是别人留的，我没扔。
lines.en: The saddle was left by others; I kept it.

lines.zh: 祖先的名字，我记不清了。
lines.en: I can't recall my ancestors' names.

lines.zh: 风把我的毛吹得立起来。
lines.en: The wind lifts my coat straight up.

lines.zh: 我从远处走来，用了很久。
lines.en: I walked here from far off; it took long.

lines.zh: 这一带冷得连狼都不来。
lines.en: It's so cold here even wolves stay away.
My hooves land and the snow shudders.

lines.zh: 我站在风口，等一个闯进来的。
lines.en: I stand in the wind, waiting for an intruder.
This place is cold; it is not the Nether.
Climbing out of lava is tiring.
Pine, ice, and your sweat.
I root my way out of the frozen earth.
Who left prints beside my den?
Under the snow it's all frozen ground.
My tusks split the snow.
My snout steams like smoke.

lines.zh: 冻原上，我的獠牙先露出来。
lines.en: On the tundra, my tusks show first.

lines.zh: 雪原的冷气，冻得我鼻子发硬。
lines.en: The snowfield cold stiffens my snout.
I came from the fires of the Nether.

lines.zh: 才从雪堆里拱出来，别催。
lines.en: I just pushed out of a snowbank; do not rush me.
Fire catches my coat; the stench stings.
Fire burns, but Nether blood does not flinch.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，獠牙先磕地。
lines.en: I fall from height and my tusks hit first.
That height. Who could take it?

lines.zh: 雪原里没有这么深的水。
lines.en: The snowfield never had water this deep.
Snowmelt up my snout.
The blast shoves me two blocks back.

lines.zh: 疣猪兽的祖先，也怕这一下。
lines.en: Even a hoglin's ancestor flinches.
An arrow sticks in the thick hide of my back.
Good shot.
A cold light seeps into my bones.
What strange force is this?
The moss is frozen hard; hunger gnaws at me.
I need to root up something frozen.

lines.zh: 雷砸在獠牙上，火星四溅。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my tusk and sparks fly.
Lightning on the tundra; that is rare.

lines.zh: 脚下雪没了，我一脚踏空。
lines.en: The snow vanishes; my hooves find nothing.

lines.zh: 冻原的雪，下面都是空的。
lines.en: Under the tundra snow, it's all hollow.
